Greendog - The Beached Surfer Dude!.name: Greendog: The Beached Surfer Dude!
Greendog - The Beached Surfer Dude!.summary: Greendog is one unlucky surfer. He lost his board and got stuck with a cursed necklace. Greendog has to fight his way past a lot of crazed creatures and monsters to find the Aztec treasure or he'll never get rid of the curse!

Jerry Glanville's Pigskin Footbrawl.name: Jerry Glanville's Pigskin Footbrawl
Jerry Glanville's Pigskin Footbrawl.summary:
Pigskin 621AD is a sort of dark-ages-medieval-fantasy-style combat rugby game in which two five-player teams take to the field to compete in a game of "footbrawl," all the while dodging rocks, trees, pools, pits, furniture and other obstacles. Each player controls the team captain of one of the teams. The original coin-op cabinet was set up with two joysticks and one screen, with both players sharing that same screen; if either player's team captain falls off the screen, he is quickly able to catch up and get back into the action.

A version for the Sega Genesis, retitled Pigskin Footbrawl and endorsed by coach Jerry Glanville, was released by Razor Soft

Super Mario World.name: Super Mario World
Super Mario World.summary: Super Mario World, also known as Super Mario Bros. (超級瑪莉兄弟), is a hack of Squirrel King loosely based on the Super Mario series of platforming games. Both the developers and publishers of the game are unknown, although it is likely the developers are connected to Gamtec in some fashion.
